notes.title: v1.5.2 - Void Damage Setting
notes.notes: A small update that allows the void damage to be modified in the host in the match settings

notes.title: v1.5.0 - New map, ability, specialty and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739023/e39c6affb1041f53cffce8b2644684527e208a51.png[/img]
Hello everyone! Version 1.5.0 is here and brings lots of new content to the game, here is a list of what I can remember:
[list]
[*]Shooting Range map, has targets you can shoot to test your damage
[*]Slow Zone ability, creates a spherical zone that makes time pass 4x slower
[*]Flesh Fuel specialty, removes ability cooldown and drains your health when using an ability instead
[*]Tips in the Character Customization in the Main Menu, these provide helpful tips about the game that you might no know.
[*]Advanced Movement setting in the Gameplay Settings, allows you to do flips when in midair
[*]Catapult in the Medieval map, allows you to launch yourself across the map
[*]Perfectly smooth movement on moving objects such as the boat on the Ocean map and flying cars in the Cloud City map.
[*]Reverb filter in the Mansion map
[/list]

The game will also be on a 50% discount as part of the Steam Autumn Sale for the next week. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: v1.4.7 - Various bug fixes
notes.notes: Not much to see here, just a few bug fixes and minor changes to a few maps

notes.title: v1.4.6 - Aiming Sensitivity
notes.notes: This update seperates sensitivity and aiming sensitivity in the settings, you can also shoot the Boomnana Split midair to blow it up instantly with extra damage.

notes.title: v.1.4.5 - Hit particles and shooting rockets
notes.notes: This small update adds subtle blood particles when hitting an enemy and allows you to shoot rockets in midair to blow them up before they hit anything

notes.title: v1.4.4 - One-shot protection and bug fixes
notes.notes: This update is pretty small, adding one shot protection (headshots bypass this), fixing some bugs, and polishing a few things that were a bit rough around the edges.

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes: Hello Everyone! This update does not change the gameplay in any way, only making the environment spookier.

notes.title: v1.4.0 - Sliding, Bow overhaul, new achievements & more!
notes.notes:
Changelog:

-Overhauled bow to be chargeable, fires higher speed and higher damage arrows based on charge.

-2 new achievements, "Death From Above" and "Pacifist"

-Sliding, allows you to go slightly faster than your walk speed as well as shrinking your hitbox, also allows you to keep your momentum

-New Colors and faces in the character customizer

-Absorption ability has been buffed, dealing and absorbing much higher damage than before

-Death effects have been reworked

-Movement on moving objects (such as the boat in the ocean map) is much less jittery

-And much more that I cant remember


Enjoy the update ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: v1.2.0 - Endless gamemode and new map
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This update comes with a new map called Mansion, which replaces the Meteor map. An Endless gamemode has also been added, a gamemode with no win condition where players can change their class at any time.

The absorption ability has been given a decent buff, and some small changes have been done to the UI for the class creation screen and the match settings.

notes.title: v1.1.0 - Bug fixes and new ability
notes.notes: This update comes with some small bug fixes as well as a new ability, enjoy! ːsteamhappyː
